# Zx

> Zx is the dependency-free, vanilla-JavaScript UI component library for ZeyOS business
> applications. ES2022 modules, WAI-ARIA-accessible native
> controls, semantic `--zx-*` design tokens with light/dark/density theming, and lifecycle-safe
> components. Source modules run directly in the browser; a build step emits ESM, IIFE-global,
> gx-compatibility, and CSS bundles. Zero runtime dependencies.

Instantiate every component as `new Component(target, options)` where `target` is an Element, a
selector string, or `null` (the component creates and owns its root, retrieved via `.toElement()`).
Subscribe with `.on(type, fn)` or an `on<type>` option; handlers receive a `CustomEvent` whose
`.detail` is an object. Call `.destroy()` to clean up. The same API is available as ESM named
exports and as `window.zx.*`.

## Documentation
- [Documentation site](../website/docs.html): getting started, every component with a live demo and its JavaScript source, and the application layouts. Machine index: [website/llms.txt](../website/llms.txt).
- [README](../README.md): what Zx is, quick start (ESM + global script), component index, theming, browser support, gx compat.
- [API reference](llms.md): per-component constructor options, methods, and events for all 30+ components plus the core helpers.
- [Skill](../.claude/skills/zx/SKILL.md): task-oriented guide — mental model, recipes, ZeyOS HTTP client, theming, gotchas, commands.
- [Migration guide](../MIGRATION.md): gx→zx class map, script-tag replacement, deliberate behavior changes, unsupported legacy APIs.
- [Contributor contract](../AGENTS.md): conventions for editing component source (token rules, render-time state, listeners, ARIA/APG).

## Components
- Inputs: `button()`, `buttonGroup()`, `badge()`/`badgeGroup()`, `CheckButton`, `Toggle`, `Search`, `Select` (APG combobox; `filter: false|'local'|async`), `Checklist`, `TagPicker`, `NumberField`, `Rating`, `DatePicker`, `MonthPicker`, `TimePicker`, `Datebox`/`DateTimeBox`, `DateRangePicker`/`DateRangeBox`, `Timebox`.
- Overlays: `Message` (toasts/inline/progress), `Modal`, `Dialog` (+ `alert`/`confirm`/`prompt` Promises), `Dropdown`, `MenuButton`, `Tooltip`/`tooltip()`/`describe()`.
- Data: `Table` (sortable, selectable, sticky header, opt-in inline cell/row editing via `editMode`), `DataFilter`, `Pagination` (+ pure `paginationRange()`), `TreeView` (APG tree), `Finder` (Miller columns).
- Forms: `Form`, `Fieldset`, `Field` (type registry), `ValueList`, `MultiValueEditor`, `FieldUpload`, `Permission`.
- Layout: `Groupbox`, `Panel` (header/footer action buttons), `MasterPanel`, `Tabbox` (`variant: 'line'|'segmented'`), `NavigationBar`, `Toolbar` (APG toolbar with overflow menu), `SplitView`, `Stepper`, `Breadcrumb`, `emptyState()`.
- Core: `Component`, `h`/`icon`, `position`, `Http`/`zeyosService`, i18n, date utils, `defineElements` (declarative `<zx-*>` custom elements).
- Helpers: `formatNumber`/`formatCurrency`/`formatPercent`/`formatFileSize`/`formatRelativeTime` (locale-aware, cached `Intl`), `debounce`/`throttle`, `groupBy`/`sortBy`/`uniqueBy`, `escapeRegExp`/`highlightMatch`, `storage()` (namespaced JSON, degrades to memory), `toCsv`/`downloadBlob`/`copyToClipboard`.

## Theming
Load `zx.css` once; set `data-zx-theme` (`light`|`dark`|`auto`) and `data-zx-density` (`cozy`|`compact`) on any ancestor. Define a product theme by overriding semantic `--zx-color-*` / `--zx-control-*` tokens under `[data-zx-theme="name"]`. Never use tier-1 palette tokens or raw color literals in application CSS.

## Talking to ZeyOS
Use the dedicated ZeyOS client library **`@zeyos/client`** (`npm install @zeyos/client`) for ZeyOS business data: `createZeyosClient({ platform, auth })`, typed `client.api.list/get/create/update<Resource>` over the full OpenAPI surface, `normalizeListResult`. It replaces the legacy `gx.zeyos.Client`/`gx.zeyos.Request`. See the `website/layouts/zeyos-invoices.layout.js` layout for a Zx-components-on-@zeyos/client reference. Zx also ships a minimal `Http`/`zeyosService` for ad-hoc in-app `remotecall`, but `@zeyos/client` is the recommended default.

## Installing
`npm install @zeyos/zx`. Entry points: `.` (components), `./zeyos` (ZeyOS binding), `./compat`
(gx namespace), `./zx.css` (styles), `./global` (classic script tag). Docs: https://zx.zeyos.com

## Commands
`npm run serve` (no-build documentation at http://127.0.0.1:8321/website/docs.html) · `npm test` (unit + token lint) · `npm run build` (dist bundles).
